description: Ladislav Bihari — Spievanky, spievanky, complete one-page heligónka arrangement issued by Miroslav Jurči / Pesničky pre všetkých. The specific score is for a two-row C/F instrument and retains the entire right-hand melody and harmonization, left-hand bass/chords, button choices and push/pull bellows directions. It is an authored instrumental realization of this complete instrumental arrangement, not a reconstruction of an unspecified vocal recording. Printed song lyrics and six verses remain source underlay/context; the publisher identifies the arrangement for heligónka, not a separate scored singer. No additional vocalist is inferred from printed words. The institutionally documented one-player heligónka practice supports this single-player realization; no claim all heligónka music is instrumental. Broad functionalSong represents the selected strophic folk-song melody and explicitly notated functional C/D-minor/F/G7 chord cycle, realized instrumentally across its verses. This does not imply Anglosphere pop/rock or through-composed concert art solely because a score exists. The isolated free-reed owner preserves four documented physical/playing dimensions: two C/F rows with eleven and ten right-hand buttons; a sixth-button F-row stoják retaining one pitch in both bellows directions; left-hand bass-plus-chord support; and explicitly scored push/pull melody phrasing. No manufacturer, reed metal, reed rank count, shell material or measured original tuning frequency is invented. Stoják-present option is selected from the score’s documented alternatives. Authored controlled live-room realization and equal-tempered baseline are editorial recording choices, not a source-session claim.
